WITH fv AS (
  SELECT member_id, join_date, home_store_id, valid_from, valid_to, is_current,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY valid_from) AS vn
  FROM dim_member
)
SELECT home_store_id, count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT member_id) AS dn, min(valid_from) mn, max(valid_from) mx
FROM fv WHERE vn=1 AND join_date = DATE '2026-09-25'
GROUP BY ROLLUP(home_store_id) ORDER BY 1
SELECT join_date, count(*) versions, count(DISTINCT member_id) members, max(valid_from) FROM dim_member WHERE join_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-20' AND DATE '2026-10-06' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH fv AS (
  SELECT member_id, join_date, valid_from, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY valid_from) AS vn
  FROM dim_member
)
SELECT 'first version valid_from=25Sep but join_date differs' AS chk, count(*) FROM fv WHERE vn=1 AND valid_from=DATE '2026-09-25' AND join_date<>DATE '2026-09-25'
UNION ALL SELECT 'join 25Sep but first valid_from differs', count(*) FROM fv WHERE vn=1 AND join_date=DATE '2026-09-25' AND valid_from<>DATE '2026-09-25'
UNION ALL SELECT 'any version with join 25Sep', count(DISTINCT member_id) FROM dim_member WHERE join_date=DATE '2026-09-25'
UNION ALL SELECT 'members with join_date varying across versions', count(*) FROM (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(DISTINCT join_date)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'member_id duplicated in is_current', count(*) FROM (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member WHERE is_current GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'max date in sales', CAST(max(sale_date) AS BIGINT) - CAST(DATE '2026-01-01' AS BIGINT) FROM fact_sales_line
